items.title: Candeias (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 3 #001
items.en_title: Candeias (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 3 #001
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Candeias (BA) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 869,368.10; proposals close Dec 3, 10:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
